meta.name: migrate-from-openclaw
meta.description: Migrate from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2. Detects an existing OpenClaw installation, extracts identity, channel credentials, scheduled tasks, and other config, then guides interactive migration. Triggers on "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration", "import from openclaw".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 迁移 OpenClaw 的配置与任务到 NanoClaw v2
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想从 OpenClaw 换到 NanoClaw,又不想丢失现有配置。
copy.tagline_en: Migrate your OpenClaw setup to NanoClaw v2 while keeping your data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are moving from OpenClaw to NanoClaw and want to keep your existing setup.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会检测你已有的 OpenClaw 安装,提取身份、渠道凭证、定时任务等配置,逐项和你讨论迁到 NanoClaw v2 的位置,确认后再写入。
howto.when: 当你提到「migrate from openclaw」、「openclaw migration」等,或要求从 OpenClaw 导入时触发。

say.text: 帮我从 OpenClaw 迁移到 NanoClaw v2
say.note: 先检测安装并给出摘要,再逐项确认

say.text: 我的 OpenClaw 装在自定义路径,帮我迁移
say.note: 会让你指定自定义路径

say.text: 迁移时把 OpenClaw 的定时任务一起带过来
say.note: 任务会映射成 v2 的定时任务

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude detects your existing OpenClaw setup, extracts identity, channel credentials, scheduled tasks and other config, then walks you through migrating to NanoClaw v2 and shows proposed changes before applying.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration" and similar, or ask to import from OpenClaw.

say_en.text: Migrate me from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2
say_en.note: Detects the install and summarizes, then confirms step by step

say_en.text: My OpenClaw is in a custom path, migrate it
say_en.note: You'll be asked for the custom path

say_en.text: Bring my OpenClaw scheduled tasks over too
say_en.note: Tasks map to v2 scheduled tasks
